title: Concatenation Core
description: Concatenation Core is a mod which adds items, armors sets, tools, blocks and other assets used in the progression of the the Concatenation modpack.
body:
Concatenation Core is a mod which adds items, armors sets, tools, blocks and other assets used in the progression of the the Concatenation modpack.

Nearly all items have no recipes provided, as they're meant to have customized recipes in a modpack with other mods' ingredients.

 

Item and blocks with special effects:

- The Berry Incubator can be filled with a water bucket and will grow Panvita after some time.

- The sword Shrike can be used to purge experience from your body into solid orbs

- The sword Kestrel can be used to teleport with experience

 

Ingredients related to other mods:

- Inductor (Create)

- Zinc Casing (Create)

- Deck & Deck Section (Swashbucklers)

- Compacted Steel (Create Metallurgy / Thermal Series)

- Meteorite (Fallen Meteors)

- Compressed Skystone (Applied Energetics 2)
- Primed Calculation Processor (Applied Energetics 2)

- Sourcesilver (Ars Nouveau)
- Copperlead & Signalum Coils (Thermal Series)

- The Error (Tarot Cards)
